gamerule.spacehorizons.vacuum_damage.des: Players suffocate in a vacuum (airless planets and above the atmosphere) when their oxygen runs out
death.attack.spacehorizons_vacuum: %1$s suffocated in the vacuum of space
death.attack.spacehorizons_vacuum.player: %1$s suffocated in the vacuum of space whilst trying to escape %2$s
advancements.spacehorizons.root.title: Look Up
advancements.spacehorizons.root.descript: A faint, steady signal is coming from the Moon. Too regular to be natural.
advancements.spacehorizons.steel_blend.d: Mix 1 iron ingot with 2 coal. Iron alone will not reach the Moon.
advancements.spacehorizons.steel_ingot.d: Smelt the steel blend in a blast furnace.
Forge a hammer out of steel ingots.
advancements.spacehorizons.steel_plate.d: Hammer two steel ingots into a plate.
advancements.spacehorizons.basic_circuit: Assemble a basic circuit. The signal needs something to listen with.
advancements.spacehorizons.refinery.desc: Build a refinery to turn coal into rocket fuel.
advancements.spacehorizons.fuel_full.des: Fill a canister with 1000 mB of rocket fuel.
advancements.spacehorizons.steel_block.d: Compress nine steel ingots into a block of steel.
jei.spacehorizons.info.fuel_canister: Craft it from 5 steel plates and 1 steel nugget. Put it in the refinery's canister slot: it fills with rocket fuel (up to 1000 mB) to carry it around.
jei.spacehorizons.info.forge_hammer: Craft it from 4 steel ingots and 2 sticks. Use it as an ingredient (for example, to make steel plates): it is not consumed, but loses 1 durability per craft.
